newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Plexus sees more sales growth in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Plexus sees more sales growth in 1996.

text.p: Bio-Plexus Inc said Wednesday it expects continued sales growth during the remainder of 1996, but expects ongoing losses from operations to continue until significant additional increases in monthly sales and further reductions in manufacturing costs are achieved.

During the third quarter, the company said it received 510K approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its needle disposal container. The company said it anticipates sales and shipments of this product to begin during the first quarter of 1997.
